title: Data-subject request handling
acceptance_scenarios: Run request-specific access/deletion/withdrawal cases with reproducible clocks, processor handoffs, justified extensions and statutory-retention refusal. Use an integrated controlled case tool if suitable.
evidence_after_implementation: A07-request-timeline.csv; redacted case-exhibit.pdf; A07-timer-tests.json; identity/refusal/extension procedures and notification records.
manual_acceptance: DPO signs the applicable response rules and case outcome. Refresh when rules or workflows change and sample real closed cases periodically; simulated tests do not show all real requests met deadlines.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
implemented_controls: Rights cases calculate Article 5 acknowledgement/completion clocks, distinguish processor involvement, enforce one justified extension with actual notice proof, and preserve acknowledgement/outcome proof. Company-scoped holiday calendar supports working-day deadlines.
remaining_actions: Publish request procedures, verify identity, configure Vietnamese holidays, communicate outcomes and review legal exceptions. Workflow actions record actual communications; they do not send them.
